item.title: MAC Minute — 2026-10-02
item.description:
Morning, MAC Fellas, let us dive straight into some heavy freight moves on this Friday. Starting with Ethiopian Airlines, which just placed a major order for ten Boeing 777F jets. Ten units is a substantial capacity play for their hub expansion, adding serious scale. Meanwhile, over at Flydubai Cargo, they have officially launched their new scheduled freighter network using B737-800 aircraft. Aiming right at that rising e-commerce and regional trade demand with dedicated payload. And in digital logistics, WiseTech is expanding direct airfreight bookings within CargoWise, shaking up independent platforms. Definitely one to watch for booking workflows. Have a great weekend, everyone.
